battle.name: 兩伊戰爭
battle.theater: 伊朗西南部胡齊斯坦戰區
battle.brief: 一九八〇年八月三十一日，伊拉克以十萬大軍越過沙提阿拉伯河攻入伊朗西南部，先取阿巴丹煉油廠與胡齊斯坦油田，再陷克爾曼沙赫爾。卡面這具一八六〇年的加特林機槍本身不在戰場上，它代表的六管分散後坐力血統，落在伊朗AH-1J攻擊直升機所掛的M134重機槍上，成為人海突擊背後的支援火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰方是兩個國家機器都被完全調動起來的對手。伊拉克一方以薩達姆·侯塞因的復興黨國家為核心，國防部與總參謀部之下設若干軍團，第三、第四軍團長期駐紮南部戰區，轄下有機械化步兵師、裝甲師與砲兵旅；直屬總統的共和國衛隊精銳中，裝甲師負責正面突破，步兵師擔任攻堅與守備，另有特別保安部隊負責首都警衛、清剿與佔領區治安；空軍序列有米格二十一、二十三、二十五、二十九與Su-22、Su-25、颶風F1以及英製「海市蜃樓」Tornado，海軍在沙提阿拉伯河以數十艘武裝快艇與登陸艇巡弋，情報行動則由穆沙拉夫情報局主導。伊朗一方是伊斯蘭共和國：正規軍歸國防部與軍事參謀總部，革命衛隊自成體系，轄地面軍、砲兵部隊與海軍航空隊，另有以志願兵形式編成的巴希人民體系，戰時一度擴張到二十萬人以上。伊朗得到的外部支援主要是蘇聯在技術與防空上的有限援助、中國與北韓的軍火，以及敘利亞、利比亞提供的資金與技術；伊拉克得到的則是美國、沙特阿拉伯、科威特、埃及、約旦、摩洛哥、法國、義大利、英國、西德、日本與南韓的貸款、軍火與情報支援，海灣產油國的石油收入是其最硬的戰爭血脈。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were rival states that had mobilised their entire national machinery. On the Iraqi side the core was Saddam Hussein's Ba'ath Party state: under the Ministry of Defence and the General Staff sat a number of army corps, the 3rd and 4th Corps remaining in the southern theatre for years and commanding mechanised infantry divisions, armoured divisions and artillery brigades; the Republican Guard, directly subordinate to the president, fielded armoured divisions for the frontal breakthrough and infantry divisions for assault and defence, while the Special Security Forces handled the capital's security, counter-insurgency and policing of the occupied zones. The air force order of battle included MiG-21, MiG-23, MiG-25 and MiG-29 fighters, Su-22 and Su-25 strike aircraft, Mirage F1s and British Tornado strike aircraft, and the navy patrolled the Shatt al-Arab with several dozen armed fast boats and landing craft, while intelligence work was directed by the Mukhabarat al-Jami'ah. On the Iranian side was the Islamic Republic: the regular army, the Artesh, answered to the Ministry of Defence and the Joint Staff, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ran as a parallel system with its own ground forces, artillery and naval aviation, and the Basij existed as a popular volunteer formation that during the war grew to more than 200,000 men. Iran's outside support was limited Soviet technical and air-defence assistance, arms from China and North Korea, and money and technical help from Syria and Libya; Iraq, by contrast, drew loans, arms and intelligence from the United States, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, France, Italy, Britain, West Germany, Japan and South Korea, with the oil revenue of the Gulf states as its hardest war-fighting artery.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩邊的最高處。伊拉克方面，總統薩達姆·侯塞因自任最高統帥，一九八〇年七月底在革命指揮委員會上拍板出兵，副總統兼委員會主席塔里克·阿齊茲力主先以空軍第一擊與砲火摧毀伊朗的空軍基地、煉油廠與邊境目標，他設計的作戰方案成為最初戰役計劃的主幹；其長子庫塞·侯塞因在八十年代末指揮對北部庫德族聚居區的「安法爾」行動。伊朗方面，最高領袖霍梅尼以「保衛聖地」的名義把全國人力物力動員起來，一九八八年設置意志與裁決委員會處理戰時大政；總理巴尼薩德在開戰前出走在海外，回國後出任總理主持戰時經濟；革命衛隊司令穆赫森·禮薩伊自一九八一年起掌控志願兵與突擊部隊的調度；阿里·哈梅內伊在戰爭初期出任革命衛隊指揮官，一九八一年起任總統，一九八〇年代後期進入最高決策層；議長拉夫桑賈尼主持國會與戰時預算，最終以總統身分在阿爾及爾簽下和平條約。伊拉克北部的庫德斯坦民主黨領袖馬蘇德·巴爾札尼在伊朗支持下於山地游擊作戰，什葉派反抗組織在南部一度武裝起事。作戰層面上，數以萬計的十六七歲少年兵被編入突擊分隊與志願兵隊伍，是伊朗方面最令人注目的身影。
peopleEn: The key figures clustered at the top of both sides. For Iraq, President Saddam Hussein was his own supreme commander and pushed the decision to invade at the Revolutionary Command Council in late July 1980; Vice-President and council chairman Tariq Aziz argued for opening with an air first strike and artillery fire to destroy Iran's air bases, refineries and border targets, and the operational plan he drew up became the backbone of the first campaigns. His elder son Qusay Hussein commanded the Anfal operations against the Kurdish settlements of the north in the late 1980s. For Iran, Supreme Leader Khomeini mobilised the country's manpower and materiel under the banner of the 'defence of the holy places', and in 1988 he set up the Expediency Council to handle wartime state business; Prime Minister Banisad had gone into exile before the war and returned to take the premiership and direct the wartime economy; IRGC commander Mohsen Rezaee controlled the deployment of the volunteers and the assault formations from 1981; Ali Khamenei commanded the Revolutionary Guard in the war's first months, became president in 1981 and entered the highest decision-making circle in the late 1980s; and Majlis speaker Ali Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani ran parliament and the war budget before signing the peace treaty in Algiers as president. Kurdish Democratic Party leader Masoud Barzani fought a mountain guerrilla war with Iranian support in northern Iraq, and Shia resistance organisations took up arms in the south for a time. At the level of the fighting, tens of thousands of boys of sixteen and seventeen were folded into the assault detachments and the volunteer formations, the most striking human presence on the Iranian side.
kits: 卡面這件一八六〇年的加特林機槍在這場戰爭中沒有本體，但它代表的技術路線正在兩個方向上同時成熟。血緣最直接的是美製M134迷你砲：伊朗在革命前已接收逾兩千架AH-1J「眼鏡蛇」攻擊直升機與一批AB-205休伊，機上掛的正是六管七點六二公厘的M134重機槍，這些炮是伊朗陸戰在戰線後方對地面集結點、巴士拉外圍與法烏半島提供支援的主要精確火力，而美軍自用的M197三十公厘加特林砲是同源的直系後代，AH-1的砲塔正是這種結構。蘇聯線上，伊拉克的米-8直升機裝NSV十二點七公厘與AGS-17三十公厘火砲，以GSh-30-2六管三十公厘旋轉砲為代表的蘇式加特林系，是伊拉克在後方對付伊朗地面突擊群的標準火力。地面裝備方面，伊拉克以蘇聯製T-62與T-72坦克、中國製六九式改裝型、美國M60A1與英國「酋長」為裝甲骨幹，另有改裝T-55的ABR-77；伊朗以T-62、五九式與改裝的「酋長」對抗，戰爭後期開始仿製T-72並加裝反應裝甲的「佐爾菲卡爾」型，自製的多管火箭炮「澤勒扎爾」則承擔縱深打擊。砲兵以一二二、一五五與一三〇公厘榴彈炮為主，伊拉克大量使用SCUD-B導彈打擊伊朗縱深城鎮與油氣設施。輕武器以AK-47系列、PKM通用機槍與FN FAL為主，伊朗大量裝備繳獲的伊拉克武器，兩軍也都配備了各型反戰車地雷與定向炸藥。
kitsEn: The 1860 Gatling gun on the card had no physical presence in this war, but the line of technology it represents was maturing in two directions at once. The closest blood relation was the American M134 Minigun: before the revolution Iran had already taken delivery of more than two thousand AH-1J Cobra attack helicopters and a batch of AB-205 Hueys, and what hung under their stub wings was precisely the six-barrel 7.62 mm M134 machine gun. Those guns gave the Iranian army the bulk of its precision support fire against assembly areas behind the line, around Basra and on the Faw peninsula, while the American M197 30 mm Gatling gun is the direct descendant of the same principle, and the AH-1 turret is built on exactly that structure. On the Soviet line, Iraqi Mi-8 helicopters carried NSV 12.7 mm and AGS-17 30 mm guns, and the Soviet Gatling family represented by the six-barrel GSh-30-2 30 mm rotary cannon was the standard fire support of Iraq in the rear against the Iranian assault masses. On the ground, Iraq's armoured backbone was Soviet T-62 and T-72 tanks, Chinese Type 69 upgrades, American M60A1 and British Chieftains, with ABR-77 rebuilds of the T-55; Iran matched them with T-62s, Type 59s and modified Chieftains, began copying the T-72 late in the war and fitting explosive reactive armour to the resulting 'Zulfiqar' type, while its domestically built multiple rocket launcher 'Zelzal' handled the deep strike. Artillery was centred on 122, 130 and 155 mm howitzers, and Iraq used SCUD-B missiles in bulk against Iranian towns and oil installations in the depth. Small arms were dominated by the AK-47 family, the PKM and the FN FAL, and Iran re-equipped itself extensively from captured Iraqi weapons; both armies also carried every sort of anti-tank mine and shaped charge.
tactics: 作戰樣式上，伊拉克在開戰第一個月仍交出二十世紀最完整的機械化戰役範本：七個師以上的兵力在沙提阿拉伯河北岸成建制展開，先以逾千門火炮與火箭炮同時射擊，再用空軍第一擊壓制伊朗空軍，裝甲師縱隊沿阿巴丹、克爾曼沙赫爾、舒什泰爾軸線推進，每天推進數公里，企圖在伊朗軍崩潰前先奪油田、煉油廠與縱深交通樞紐；十一月四日代號「喀麥隆九九」的攻勢是伊拉克最後一次大規模進攻，三個師與二百多輛坦克在舒什泰爾以南受阻，此後伊拉克轉入固守。伊朗的戰術在頭一年最原始：正規軍節節敗退後，靠巴希志願兵以人海戰術沿公路與山脊以連續縱隊衝擊，用人數換取突破；一九八一年底「卡爾巴拉一號」反攻在二百公里戰線上同時發動，靠鼓聲、口哨與手電訊號協調，才重新拿下克爾曼沙赫爾；一九八二年一月「貝特-奧爾-莫卡達斯」與四月的「齋月」作戰奪回舒什泰爾與巴士拉。北部方面，伊拉克一九八七年一月為奪法烏半島發動代號「伊斯蘭國家」的攻勢失敗，伊朗同年七月反手奪回半島，切斷巴士拉出海通道。海灣方面，一九八四年起伊拉克以米格機與Tu-22自巴士拉飛彈基地襲擊油輪，伊朗以C-802飛彈、水雷與快艇作群狼式攻擊商船；一九八七年起美國組建「埃爾內斯特·威爾」護航艦隊，四月「長者中士」行動中伊朗水雷擊傷美軍護衛艦，五月「祈禱螳螂」行動雙方海空交火，六月起「靈巧弓」行動美軍轟炸伊朗油氣平台並封鎖航道。化學戰術是最惡劣的一環：一九八三年起伊拉克以砲彈與空投毒劑攻擊伊朗前線與北部城鎮，一九八七年三月十六日夜空襲哈拉卜賈，攻擊重點不是鋼筋混凝土工事，而是沒有防毒裝備的密集居住區與野戰陣地。
tacticsEn: Operationally, Iraq's first month produced what is still one of the most complete set pieces of the mechanised war in the twentieth century: more than seven divisions deployed in line north of the Shatt al-Arab, an opening barrage from over a thousand guns and rocket launchers, an air first strike to neutralise the Iranian air force, and armoured columns pushing along the Abadan, Kermanshahr and Shushtar axes at a few kilometres a day, in the hope of taking the oilfields, the refineries and the transport pivots of the interior before the Iranian army collapsed. The offensive of 4 November 1980, code-named 'Kaman-99', was Iraq's last large-scale attack; three divisions and more than two hundred tanks were checked south of Shushtar, and after that Iraq went over to the defensive. Iran's tactics in the first year were the crudest: with the regular army giving way piecemeal, the Basij volunteers went in human waves, pushing in continuous columns along the roads and the ridges and trading numbers for breach. The counter-offensive 'Karbala-1' of late 1981 was launched simultaneously along a two hundred kilometre front and coordinated by drums, whistles and torch signals, and it was this that retook Khorramshahr; 'Beit-ol-Moqaddas' in January 1982 and 'Ramadan' in April took back Shushtar and Basra. In the north, Iraq's January 1987 offensive code-named 'Islamic State' to seize the Faw peninsula failed, and Iran retook the peninsula in July of the same year, cutting the sea outlet of Basra. In the Gulf, from 1984 Iraq struck at tankers with MiGs and Tu-22s flying out of Basra, while Iran answered with C-802 missiles, mines and fast boats hunting merchant ships in packs; the United States built up the 'Earnest Will' escort force from 1987, Iranian mines damaged an American escort in the 'Elder Sergeant' action of April 1988, the two sides traded fire at sea and in the air in the 'Praying Mantis' action of May, and from June the 'Nimble Archer' campaign saw American strikes on Iranian oil platforms and a blockade of the shipping lanes. The ugliest layer was the chemical one: from 1983 Iraq used artillery shells and air-delivered agent against the Iranian front and the towns of the north, and on the night of 16 March 1987 the air attack on Halabja aimed not at reinforced concrete positions but at densely built residential areas and field positions without protective equipment.
data: 可核對的數字多出自戰後聯合國的調查與各國官方統計，但爭議極大。時間上，自一九八〇年八月三十一日伊拉克越境開火，到一九八八年八月二十日伊朗接受安理會第五九八號決議後全面停火，交火歷時約八年；最後的正式和約直到一九九〇年三月二十日才在阿爾及爾簽署，前後接近十年。兵力方面，伊拉克首波投入約十萬人、逾千輛坦克與數百架飛機，峰值兵力約四十萬至五十萬；伊朗可動員的正規軍與革命衛隊合計逾一百萬，另有二十萬至五十萬巴希志願者。損失方面，伊朗陣亡人數各方估算自二十五萬至五十萬不等，受傷者以百萬計；伊拉克陣亡約二萬五千至六萬七千，受傷逾三十萬。化學武器造成的傷亡，戰後估算受影響者約二萬五千至三萬人、死亡數千至萬人量級不等，數字本身的差距就是這場戰爭的寫照。商船方面，統計口徑雖有出入，海灣內被擊中或擊沉的商船總數以數百艘計，一九八七年一個月內的油輪攻擊就造成數十名船員死亡。經濟上，兩國軍費開支合計以千億美元計；一九八六年的油價崩跌由日均產量近兩千萬桶的供應與戰爭需求共同造成，國際油價由每桶三十美元上下跌至十美元左右。此外，戰爭造成大批跨境流動，數十萬伊朗人居留伊拉克，數百萬伊拉克人與科威特人進入伊朗境內。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers come mostly from post-war United Nations investigations and the official statistics of the parties, and the disagreement is enormous. On timing: from Iraq's crossing on 31 August 1980 to the general ceasefire after Iran accepted Security Council resolution 598 on 20 August 1988, the shooting lasted about eight years, and the formal peace treaty was not signed until 20 March 1990 in Algiers, close to ten years from start to finish. On forces: Iraq committed about 100,000 men, over a thousand tanks and several hundred aircraft in the opening wave and peaked at some 400,000 to 500,000; Iran could mobilise more than a million regular and Revolutionary Guard troops, with a further 200,000 to 500,000 Basij volunteers. On losses: estimates of the Iranian dead run from 250,000 to 500,000, with the wounded counted in hundreds of thousands; Iraq lost perhaps 25,000 to 67,000 dead and more than 300,000 wounded. On chemical weapons, post-war estimates put the exposed at roughly 25,000 to 30,000 and the dead anywhere from the low thousands to the tens of thousands, and the width of that spread is itself a description of the war. On merchant shipping, the counting differs but the total number of ships hit or sunk in the Gulf runs into the hundreds, and a single month of tanker attacks in 1987 killed several dozen seamen. On economics, the combined military spending of the two sides ran into the hundreds of billions of dollars, and the oil price collapse of 1986 was produced jointly by supply of nearly twenty million barrels a day and the demand of the war itself, taking international crude from around thirty dollars a barrel to roughly ten. In addition, the fighting drove large cross-border movements, with hundreds of thousands of Iranians resident in Iraq and millions of Iraqis and Kuwaitis inside Iran.
cause: 開戰的直接導火線是沙提阿拉伯河水道與邊界島嶼的爭端。一九六九年兩國在邊境交火，經阿爾及爾調解簽訂協議，把水道主權暫歸伊拉克並共同管理；一九七五年《阿爾及爾協議》確認同一安排，但伊朗拒絕承認水道歸屬伊拉克，並在河中島嶼與界線走向上長期異議。宗教與內政層面，一九七九年伊朗革命建立了主張對外輸出革命示範的伊斯蘭共和國，霍梅尼公開表示願意以武力支援伊拉克境內的什葉派，一九八〇年初納杰夫、卡爾巴拉等地的什葉派起事與隨後被清剿的「巴基爾事件」讓薩達姆感到生存受威脅；反過來，伊朗革命內部失序、正規軍士氣低落、煉油與港口運作混亂，則讓薩達姆相信新政權虛弱可欺，估計數月之內伊朗軍就會崩潰，決定先發制人。經濟上，伊拉克靠石油收入維持龐大軍備，而伊朗革命後石油產量銳減、外匯枯竭，戰爭同時成了伊拉克爭取海灣石油收入與轉移內部矛盾的手段。超級大國層面，美國因人質危機與對伊制裁在革命後切斷對伊軍援、把重心倒向海灣石油國，蘇聯則不想得罪阿拉伯世界而在開戰初期按兵不動，兩邊都沒有及時制肘。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the dispute over the Shatt al-Arab waterway and the frontier islands. The two sides clashed along the border in 1969, and an agreement brokered by Algeria left the sovereignty of the waterway with Iraq under joint administration; the 1975 Algiers Agreement confirmed the same arrangement, but Iran refused to accept Iraqi sovereignty over the channel and maintained its objections over the mid-river islands and the line of the boundary. On the religious and internal front, the 1979 Iranian revolution created an Islamic Republic that proclaimed the export of revolution, and Khomeini openly offered armed support to the Shia of Iraq; the Shia rising at Najaf, Karbala and elsewhere in early 1980, and the subsequent crushing of the Al-Bakir affair, convinced Saddam that his own position was threatened. Conversely, the disorder inside revolutionary Iran, the low morale of the regular army and the confusion of the refineries and the ports led Saddam to judge the new regime weak and collapsible, expecting the Iranian army to disintegrate within months, and he decided to strike first. Economically, Iraq maintained a huge military establishment on oil revenue, while the revolution cut Iranian production and dried up its foreign exchange, so the war was also a means for Iraq to capture Gulf oil income and to divert internal tension. Among the superpowers, the United States, after the hostage crisis and the sanctions, cut off arms to Iran and leaned towards the Gulf oil states, while the Soviet Union, unwilling to offend the Arab world, held its hand in the opening phase; neither constrained the other side in time.
impact: 這場戰爭是二戰以來規模最大的常規戰爭之一，也是第一次大戰之後化學武器第一次被大規模用於實戰，對國際法與軍備控制的衝擊遠大於戰場本身。聯合國安理會在一九八八年七月二十三日以九票通過第五九八號決議，開創超級大國不再為代理人戰爭互相否決的先例；戰後的《禁止化學武器公約》與國際禁用公約體系都把這場戰爭當作主要反面案例。對伊朗而言，戰爭催生「國防神聖地」的敘事，把革命衛隊推上國家權力核心，讓最高領袖與軍隊綁在一起，塑造出革命後伊朗的軍事文化與對外強硬路線，一九八九年霍梅尼去世後的權力交接也由此定型。對伊拉克而言，薩達姆以巨額負債與內部權力集中換來海灣霸權，卻也把國家推向一九九〇年入侵科威特的冒險。庫德問題被徹底改寫：北部安法爾行動與哈拉卜賈毒氣攻擊摧毀了伊拉克北部的城鄉，十萬至二十餘萬庫德人被強制遷往南部沙漠城鎮，境外則形成以巴爾札尼為核心、帶領數百萬流亡者的政治勢力。兩國的邊界與民族格局至此固定，伊拉克什葉派的政治地位被壓制了二十多年；海灣國家的財政與政策則從此綁在油價週期上，石油成為比國防更敏感的政治議題。
impactEn: This war was among the largest conventional conflicts since the Second World War and the first large-scale use of chemical weapons since the First, and its effect on international law and arms control reached far beyond the battlefield. On 23 July 1988 the United Nations Security Council passed resolution 598 by nine votes, opening the precedent that the superpowers would no longer veto each other over proxy wars; the Chemical Weapons Convention and the wider disarmament system that followed both treat this war as their principal counter-example. For Iran the war produced the narrative of the 'defence of the holy places', lifted the Revolutionary Guard to the centre of state power, bound the supreme leader to the army, and fixed the military culture and the hard-line foreign policy of post-revolutionary Iran; the succession that followed Khomeini's death in 1989 was shaped in the same mould. For Iraq, Saddam bought a Gulf hegemony with crushing debt and the concentration of power at the centre, and in doing so pushed the country towards the gamble of invading Kuwait in 1990. The Kurdish question was rewritten: the Anfal campaign in the north and the gas attack on Halabja wrecked the towns and villages of northern Iraq, some 100,000 to 250,000 Kurds were forcibly moved to desert towns in the south, and in exile a political movement gathered around Barzani and led hundreds of thousands away. The frontiers and the ethnic map of the two states were now fixed, and the political position of the Shia in Iraq was suppressed for more than two decades; for the Gulf states, finances and policy became tied to the oil cycle, and petroleum became a political issue more sensitive than defence.
result: 結果是典型的僵局收場，雙方都宣稱勝利，戰線基本回到戰前位置，但沒有一方取得決定性戰果。一九八八年八月八日伊拉克趁伊朗換血發動代號「黎明」的總攻，奪回部分城鎮，伊朗隨即在九日零時發動反擊迫其接受停火，二十日伊朗正式接受第五九八號決議，聯合國伊朗伊拉克軍事觀察團進駐前線監督，交火自此逐步停止。僵持的破局靠的是外交而不是戰場：拉夫桑賈尼與阿齊茲先後在阿爾及爾談判，一九九〇年三月二十日簽訂《阿爾及爾和平條約》，以水道等分線為界、爭議島嶼歸伊拉克並實行非軍事化，雙方交換戰俘並規範邊界軍事安排；法烏半島在一九八七年七月被伊朗收復，停火時仍由伊朗控制。裝備層面的結論是：加特林機槍那條以六管分散後坐力的血統，在這場戰爭中以M134與GSh-30-2的形式留在兩邊的直升機與後方火力點上，伊朗AH-1J與AB-205提供的人海突擊所需的近距離火力，與伊拉克武裝直升機構成的火力牆，一起成為消耗戰的骨架；而最終決定戰爭長短的，是後勤、士氣與外部供給，不是任何一種砲管的口徑。
resultEn: The outcome was a stalemate in the classic sense: both sides claimed victory, the front returned broadly to its pre-war position, and neither won a decisive result. On 8 August 1988 Iraq took advantage of the reshuffle in Iranian command to launch an all-out offensive code-named 'Dawn', taking back some towns; Iran struck back at midnight on the 9th and forced the fighting to stop, and on the 20th formally accepted resolution 598, after which the United Nations Iran-Iraq Military Observer Group deployed to supervise the line and the shooting wound down by degrees. What broke the deadlock was diplomacy and not the battlefield: Rafsanjani and Aziz negotiated in Algiers in turn, and on 20 March 1990 they signed the Algiers Peace Treaty, taking the median line of the waterway as the border, returning the disputed islands to Iraq with a demilitarised zone, exchanging prisoners and regularising the military arrangements on the frontier; the Faw peninsula, retaken by Iran in July 1987, was still held by Iran at the ceasefire. The conclusion at the level of equipment is this: the bloodline represented by the Gatling gun, spreading the recoil over six barrels, survived in this war in the form of the M134 and the GSh-30-2 carried on the helicopters and the rear fire positions of both sides; the close-range fire that Iran's AH-1Js and AB-205s provided for the human-wave assaults, together with the wall of fire built by Iraqi armed helicopters, formed the skeleton of the war of attrition. And what finally decided the length of the war was logistics, morale and outside supply, not the calibre of any single barrel.
